reply_text:
@Gideon Sato: you first reported the kiosks offline at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**, in this channel. Your message said both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan.

The channel only records one thing about the guard: at 10:42 they were "writing trailer numbers on a clipboard." Mateo Quiroga's 11:03 AM post says the guard checked in trailer 8836 once kiosk 1 was back, and dispatch could see it. Nothing else in the channel covers the guard's activity between those times.
